evidence_limit: Authored translation and offline runtime contracts. Private counters, scalar narrow interfaces and wildcard rename mappings are explicit Pythonic extensions without native compiler, ABI, filesystem transaction or controller acceptance claims.

private_using_counters.identity: Each independent computed capture owns an internal whole-root protection identity; nested live references inherit it and public source_root remains null
private_using_counters.protection: Exact INTEGER leaf only; reject direct, service, handler and writable alias effects against the entire active root, including retained external/handler aliases
private_using_counters.lifetime: Capture reference and bounds once; preserve iteration across same-loop jumps and pause; clear initialized selected leaf on scope exit, error, RETURN, ABORT or stop
private_using_counters.boundary: No source copy-back, synthetic global variable, private connected timer, direct function-result counter syntax or serialized suspended stack

scalar_narrow.storage: Pythonic BYTE/SHORT globals, locals, transparent aliases, formals and initialized results; preserve existing aggregate domains
scalar_narrow.domains: BYTE 0..255 and initial unknown marker with UNINIT blocked; SHORT -32768..32766 with 32767 clearing storage
scalar_narrow.arguments: Exact matching bare storage keeps reference aliasing; mismatched integral actuals create checked private writable cells without copy-back; INTEGER/REAL promotions remain values
scalar_narrow.results: Scalar narrow RETURN requires initialized checked data; SHORT 32767 cannot escape as a missing scalar result
scalar_narrow.binary_read: Validate raw decoded values before publication and let setters normalize SHORT 32767 once across ordinary, pipe and serial FILE readers; incomplete or invalid reads preserve outputs and cursor
scalar_narrow.boundary: Narrow FOR counters and scalar CREATE_VAR remain blocked; strict legacy declarations/interfaces retain aggregate-only restrictions

wildcard_rename.selection: Sorted bounded nonrecursive final-name stars and whole-stem/extension templates, including standalone star for extensionless names
wildcard_rename.preflight: No overwrite; validate every source, target, busy handle, path, alias, overlap, collision and budget before mutation; require one ordinary bank/virtual volume or one plain PIP bank
wildcard_rename.publication: Memory/device/pipe publication retains original byte/configuration objects and bank dictionary identities; same-volume device quota/garbage is unchanged
wildcard_rename.directory: Each rooted directory rename is atomic under its existing backend; late host failure may retain earlier completed renames and does not promise rollback
wildcard_rename.boundary: Cross-bank/volume, DAQ/socket routes, native wildcard semantics and filesystem transactions remain unsupported

strict_mode: Future milestone; preserve legacy tests and historical semantic ledgers
